text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeating Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross, 
Super Creek ran a fantastic race at the 
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an interview held after the race, she 
reflects on the journey so far as a trial 
meant to help her and her Trainer grow 
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, she shared her aspirations with 
the reporters, expressing her desire to 
run in the coveted Osaka Hai as her next 
goal.
